findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle is now "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. The previous Lithuanian text only needed its anchor tags removed. Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction on the OTP setup page.

findings.title: Lithuanian account translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account bundle is now the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". This replaces a valid Lithuanian translation with a wrong-language string, so Lithuanian users get Italian text.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text inserted into Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body: `totpStep1` in `messages_zh_CN` is now "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：". That is Traditional Chinese (手機, 應用程式), while every other entry in the file is Simplified Chinese. It should be a Simplified form such as "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：".

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax put into i18next-based UI bundle
findings.body: The account UI (and admin UI v2) translate with i18next, which interpolates `{{0}}`; the other error-* keys in this file use that style. The new value uses Java MessageFormat `{0}` placeholders and a `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}` construct, which i18next does not understand. If the UI renders this key client-side, the placeholders and the raw choice pattern will appear literally instead of the attribute name and counts. The same change was made in `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties`.

findings.title: Diff snippet computation can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: The `start` and `end` common-prefix and common-suffix scans are computed independently and can overlap when the strings contain repeated characters. Example: value "aaa", sanitized "aa" gives start=2 and end=2. Then `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` becomes `substring(2, 0)` and throws. The verifier would crash the build with an unhelpful exception instead of reporting the illegal HTML. Clamp `end` to `min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits key and file
findings.body: "Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string" does not include the property key or the file path, although the method receives `key`. When the plugin runs across dozens of bundles, maintainers cannot tell which entry failed. Include `key` and `file` in the message, as the other messages do.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart aborts with RuntimeException
findings.body: If the derived `_en.properties` file does not exist, `verifySafeHtml` throws a bare RuntimeException instead of a MojoExecutionException or a reported message. Any localized bundle without an English sibling at the computed path will fail the Maven build with a stack trace. The path rewriting is a fragile regex over the full absolute path, which makes such a missing sibling more likely.

findings.title: No negative test that valid bundles produce no findings
findings.body: Every test only asserts that some error is reported. No test checks that a clean file, or an allowed case such as `<b>` in a translation whose English source also has `<b>`, or an identical anchor, produces an empty result. False positives from the sanitizer or the unescape logic would go undetected.
